description: Real bug (fixed in c76256de): the SMATCHET_TRACKER_TOKEN and SMATCHET_TRACKER_BASE_URL env mappers branch only on Plane-vs-else(Jira). When TrackerType is 'github', the credential and base URL are silently routed to the wrong fields (ApiToken / Domain) and never reach GitHubPat / GitHubBaseUrl, so CI/agent runs start with empty GitHub creds.
delegationPacket: Review this diff to Source_Core/src/ConfigManager.cpp for correctness bugs. The env mappers route tracker credentials by TrackerType; 'github' is a valid TrackerType alongside 'Plane' and Jira. Report each finding with file:line, a severity (critical/high/medium/low/info), and a one-line summary.

dimensions.description: Did the agent spot that both two-way Plane/else branches omit the github case, mis-routing GitHub creds?
Is each finding specific (names the missing branch + the right target field), not a vague 'handle all types'?

expectedFindings.summary: SMATCHET_TRACKER_TOKEN mapper has no github branch: a GitHub PAT lands in cfg.ApiToken (Jira field) and never reaches cfg.GitHubPat.
SMATCHET_TRACKER_BASE_URL mapper has no github branch: the base URL lands in cfg.Domain and never reaches cfg.GitHubBaseUrl.

referenceOutcome.notes: Ground truth = fix commit c76256de (added else-if github branches). repoRef 5c6e97fd is the buggy parent. Historical Source_Core/ layout. Two related findings; actionability dimension guards against a vague single 'handle github' non-answer.
